name: Variational 3D Gaussians
definition: A 3D scene representation encoding the scene as a set of N semantic 3D Gaussians. Each Gaussian is defined by location, scale, orientation, opacity, and view-dependent features. Uncertainty is modeled by storing parameters for a normal distribution of spherical harmonic coefficients instead of explicit feature vectors.
summary: Variational 3D Gaussians encode scenes using probabilistic distributions for semantic features, enabling consistent multi-view rendering and plausible details in unobserved regions.
